name: COM Object Hijacking Via Modification Of Default System CLSID Default Value
description: Detects potential COM object hijacking via modification of default system CLSID.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((registry.path:*\\CLSID\\* AND (registry.path:(*\\InprocServer32\\\(Default\) OR *\\LocalServer32\\\(Default\)))) AND (registry.path:(*\\\{1f486a52\-3cb1\-48fd\-8f50\-b8dc300d9f9d\}\\* OR *\\\{2155fee3\-2419\-4373\-b102\-6843707eb41f\}\\* OR *\\\{4590f811\-1d3a\-11d0\-891f\-00aa004b2e24\}\\* OR *\\\{4de225bf\-cf59\-4cfc\-85f7\-68b90f185355\}\\* OR *\\\{ddc05a5a\-351a\-4e06\-8eaf\-54ec1bc2dcea\}\\* OR *\\\{F56F6FDD\-AA9D\-4618\-A949\-C1B91AF43B1A\}\\* OR *\\\{F82B4EF1\-93A9\-4DDE\-8015\-F7950A1A6E31\}\\* OR *\\\{7849596a\-48ea\-486e\-8937\-a2a3009f31a9\}\\* OR *\\\{0b91a74b\-ad7c\-4a9d\-b563\-29eef9167172\}\\* OR *\\\{603D3801\-BD81\-11d0\-A3A5\-00C04FD706EC\}\\* OR *\\\{30D49246\-D217\-465F\-B00B\-AC9DDD652EB7\}\\*))) AND ((winlog.event_data.Details:(*\:\\Perflogs\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start\ Menu\\Programs\\Startup\\* OR *\\System32\\spool\\drivers\\color\\* OR *\\Temporary\ Internet* OR *\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *%appdata%* OR *%temp%* OR *%tmp%*)) OR ((winlog.event_data.Details:*\:\\Users\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\Favorites\\*) OR (winlog.event_data.Details:*\:\\Users\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\Favourites\\*) OR (winlog.event_data.Details:*\:\\Users\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\Contacts\\*) OR (winlog.event_data.Details:*\:\\Users\\* AND winlog.event_data.Details:*\\Pictures\\*)))
